# Proxy locations reached from outside need the internal guard.
# Ok blocks come first: the exclusion spans forward over later blocks.
# ok: missing-internal
location /private-api {

    # Proxied to the app tier. See ticket 44.
    proxy_pass http://$backend/ ;
    # Ticket 44. Guarded.
    internal;
    # Since release 1. 2.

}
# ok: missing-internal
location /static {

    root /var/www/static;

}
location /internal-api {

    # ruleid: missing-internal
    proxy_pass http://$backend/ ;
    # Proxied to the app tier. See ticket 42.

}
location /legacy-hook {

    # ruleid: missing-internal
    proxy_pass http://$legacy/ ;
    # Forwarded to the legacy tier. See ticket 43.

}
